content:
maria_marketing: Quick ask — we're finalizing a social post claiming "2x faster embedding retrieval" for small models. Can runtime run a compact benchmark for mana-embedding-384 (quantized q4_k) on A100 and A10G so we can validate numbers? Need p50/p95 + embeddings/sec and peak GPU mem for cold vs warmed cache.

noah_runtime: Yep. Couple quick q's: do you want identical input set across both GPUs? what batch sizes should we run? and do you want variable-length inputs (short/medium/long)?

maria_marketing: Use the same inputs (I'll upload samples.json with 50 varied texts). Run batch sizes [1,8,32]. Include a cold-start run (fresh container) and a warmed run (after 10 warmup requests). Capture p50/p95/embeddings_per_sec and gpu_mem_peak. We also want a CSV and one-slide summary (2 bullets + 3 numbers) for the marketing deck.

sophie_eng: heads up: on A10G + q4_k, batch 32 with the longest texts may OOM. If that happens, cap to batch 16 and note it in the methodology. We should also log `--seed 1234` for reproducibility.

noah_runtime: Good note Sophie. We'll set seed=1234 and an automatic OOM backoff that retries smaller batch sizes; we'll surface any caps in the summary. Queueing two jobs now.

benchbot: Jobs queued: marketing-embed/1729954321-a100 (A100, q4_k, batches 1/8/32) & marketing-embed/1729954321-a10g (A10G, q4_k, batches 1/8/32). ETA ~30m. Artifacts will land under /bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/.

maria_marketing: One more ask: flag any sample with >1.5x embeddings/sec variance vs the median across replicates — we may drop those from the headline numbers (but include raw traces). Also, please include GPU mem peak and host RAM peak in the CSV.

noah_runtime: Will do. Outputs: (1) compact CSV with p50/p95/emb_per_sec/gpu_mem/host_mem per batch, (2) raw jsonl traces, (3) short methodology note describing samples, warmup, and seed, (4) slide-ready summary. We will also include the command we ran, e.g. `run_bench --model mana-embedding-384 --quant q4_k --seed 1234 --batches 1,8,32`.

benchbot: A100 run complete. Artifacts: /bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/a100/ (csv, traces, methodology, summary).

benchbot: A10G run complete. Note: batch 32 capped to 16 on A10G due to OOM for longest texts; details in methodology. Artifacts: /bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/a10g/.

maria_marketing: Incredible, thank you!! Please paste public links to the CSV and the 1-slide summary here when available. :sparkles: :tada:

noah_runtime: Pasted: https://redwood-internal/s3/bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/a100/summary_slide.pdf and https://redwood-internal/s3/bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/a100/results.csv (A100).

noah_runtime: And for A10G: https://redwood-internal/s3/bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/a10g/summary_slide.pdf and https://redwood-internal/s3/bench/artifacts/marketing/1729954321/a10g/results.csv. See methodology note for the OOM cap on batch 32 for A10G.

sophie_eng: skimmed artifacts. FYI one sample (id=37) has ~2.3x slower p95 on A10G vs median; flagged in the CSV under `outlier=true`. Might be network hiccup on that run.

maria_marketing: Perfect — we'll use the A100 warmed p95 and embeddings/sec for the headline, and add a small footnote about A10G cap. Thanks team! :rocket:
